purpose: Distributional evidence (periodogram variability, KS/QQ vs Exponential(1)) that a mean-PSD-only check cannot provide -- this is exactly what would fail under the obsolete fixed-modulus sampler described in the superseded Paper 1 Equation 81.
acceptance_note: No single p-value is treated as a pass/fail gate (a lucky or unlucky draw is not evidence); the KS statistic is reported across 5 fixed seeds and via the pooled histogram/QQ figure for visual and quantitative distributional agreement.
